findings.problem: The advertised sourceManifestSha256 is only compared to local-release.json. Only aggregates.ts and that receipt are compared to the Git feature tree. A changed imported shared validator, aggregate service or dependency/runtime input can reach schema import and later proof with both checked blobs and the claimed full manifest unchanged. sourceGate only checks remote CI/deployment and does not close this local binding gap.
findings.actualCounterfactual: The exact pre-import function prefix, with only import.meta.url parameterized, accepts a changed synthetic shared-dependency file and reaches the schema-import boundary. The unchanged control passes and route-blob drift is correctly refused. No actual TypeScript dependency import or live execution was performed.
findings.prescribedFix: Before importing application code, recompute the current complete source/dependency-input manifest using the same reviewed integration filter, compare it to the frozen local-release manifest and the exact feature Git tree, and reject unexpected/untracked/different inputs. Bind the actual runtime/dependency installation used by the schema loader. Recheck this binding in sourceGate before authentication and before/after capture. An isolated frozen feature checkout with verified dependency/runtime inputs is an acceptable alternative.
findings.regression: Current shared/service or package/lock input drift must fail before import/auth; source drift after initial validation must fail before capture. Keep unchanged and direct-route-drift controls.

The run correctly remains incomplete, but the independent best-effort revocation read required by the preparation is missing on exactly the uncertain path.
findings.actualCounterfactual: The exact closeContext closure, with a captured synthetic request function, performs only sign-out when it throws; the desired independent original-cookie /me assertion fails. Normal logout verifies the original cookie, a still-live cookie is refused, and another context can still be cleaned after the first timeout.
findings.prescribedFix: Attempt sign-out and original-cookie /me independently while retaining the private original cookie through both bounded attempts. Preserve the original timeout/auth uncertainty; a later401 must not invent a logout200 or clear unresolvedAuth. Keep the overall run incomplete on any unknown, continue cleanup of remaining contexts, and clear the in-memory cookie only after both attempts.
findings.regression: Timeout/malformed logout must still attempt original-cookie /me; normal200/401 passes, current200 fails, unresolved sign-in/logout uncertainty remains and all other contexts are independently attempted.
